input.command: cd D:\pal; echo "== any service mentioning sql/db/pg =="; Get-Service -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -match 'postgres|pgsql|database' } | Select-Object Name,DisplayName,Status | Format-Table -AutoSize; echo "== registry uninstall entries =="; Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*','HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -match 'Postgre|pgAdmin' } | Select-Object DisplayName,InstallLocation,DisplayVersion | Format-List; echo "== targeted dirs =="; @('C:\Program Files','D:\','C:\','E:\') | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem $_ -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'postgres|pgsql|pgadmin' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName }
